angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 592,736 km at 178.76 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 5.5942 +/- 0.0189 mas (same row, RUWE 0.82): 178.76 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.852 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Radzom et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-5143 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..189R/abstract): 592,736 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.864 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Radzom et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-5143 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..189R/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5183 +/- 125 K from Radzom et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5143 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..189R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Radzom et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-5143 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..189R/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-5143.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.514, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5143 (pscomppars): spectral type K V, from Radzom et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..189R/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-5143: main object type *, Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5143 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.107 dex, from Radzom et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..189R/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5143 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.28635, from TICv8 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....158..138S/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5143 (pscomppars): age 7.4 Gyr, from Radzom et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..189R/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-5143 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.53 km/s, from Radzom et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169..189R/abstract)
rotationPeriodMeasuredSource: Measured in this project from the TESS mission's own 2-minute light curves of sectors 45 and 72 (packages/telescope-cli/src/archives/tess/reduce.mts), by the method and criteria of Holcomb et al. (2022, ApJ 936, 138): 4.27 d, the light swinging by 0.48% as the star turns

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
